_comment: ECS service definition for buttercupp-api behind an ALB. WebSocket support requires two ALB knobs beyond a default HTTP service: (1) target-group stickiness so the same client re-lands on the same task for the WS upgrade sequence, and (2) an idle timeout raised well above the default 60s so long-lived chat streams do not disconnect. Redis pub/sub (see backend/src/queue/ws-notify.ts) handles cross-task fan-out for media.ready.

_alb_target_group_attributes._comment: Apply on the target group itself via aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes.

_alb_listener_rules._comment: Idle timeout must be raised on the ALB (not the target group) via aws elbv2 modify-load-balancer-attributes. Suggested 300s. HTTPS listener terminates TLS; forwards to HTTP on the target group.
